parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top movable part of the dispenser, made of durable ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It is pressed by the user to pump liquid soap or lotion from the container through the nozzle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns upward via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head includes the nozzle and connecting tube, typically made of stainless steel for corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the internal pump to the outside, dispensing it in a controlled stream.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed relative to the lid but allows fluid flow through internal channels.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of ceramic with decorative surface patterns.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid soap or lotion and provides structural support for the pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation and serves as the main housing for the liquid.
